## What We Usually Focus On... {auto-animate=true}

::: {style="margin-top: 100px; text-align: center; font-size: 1.2em; color: #aaa;"}
As data professionals, we spend most of our time making sure the baseline is flawless:
:::

::: {#framework-grid data-id="framework-grid" style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 30px; margin-top: 50px; max-width: 1200px; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;"}

::: {#box-rational data-id="box-rational" style="background: #1a3a2a; border: 3px solid #2e6f40; padding: 40px; border-radius: 12px; opacity: 1;"}
### [1. Integrity & Transparency]{style="color: #4ade80;"}

* **Data Accuracy:** Clean data, clear labeling.
* **Source & Intent:** Citation, peer review, objectivity.
* *Status: Crucial, non-negotiable, and where we spend our time.*
:::

::: {#box-emotional data-id="box-emotional" style="background: #222; border: 2px dashed #444; padding: 40px; border-radius: 12px; opacity: 0.3;"}
### [2. The Overlooked Dimensions]{style="color: #666;"}

* Execution & Aesthetics
* Psychological Alignment
* *Status: Often dismissed as "superficial styling."*
:::

:::

## The Takeaway: Design Earns the Right to be Read

::: {style="margin-top: 120px; text-align: center; max-width: 1000px; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;"}

::: {style="font-size: 2em; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; line-height: 1.4;"}
"Data integrity builds the truth, but quality and design build the *bridge* to that truth."
:::

::: {style="margin-top: 50px; font-size: 1.3em; color: #aaa; text-align: left;"}
* **Without Quality:** Excellent data is dismissed as amateurish or suspicious.
* **Without Familiarity:** Complex data induces anxiety and cognitive rejection.
* **Without Personal Intuition:** The user lacks the raw confidence to act on your insights.
:::

:::
